title.en: Trustworthy ownership and attentive pet care

text.en: Clients describe owner Tanya and her team as dependable, conscientious, and genuinely devoted to pet wellbeing. Pet parents appreciate thorough introductory meetings where the sitter takes time to learn each animal's personality, daily routine, and household environment in detail.

title.en: Regular visit reports and photo updates

text.en: Reviewers highlight consistent, responsive communication throughout pet sitting and dog walking bookings. Owners value receiving detailed notes and photos after every visit, alongside a dedicated app that securely tracks emergency contacts, feeding schedules, and direct client messaging.

Pet owners commend the service for handling pets with specialized care, including elderly cats, mobility-impaired felines, and anxious dogs. Reviewers consistently return to happy, relaxed animals and clean living areas, expressing immense relief and peace of mind while away from home.

q.en: Do pet sitters provide daily updates and photos?

a.en: Yes, clients receive detailed visit notes and photographs after every visit through a dedicated mobile application.

q.en: Does Top Tails accommodate pets with medical or mobility needs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report conscientious care for pets requiring scheduled medication, bathroom assistance, or mobility support.

q.en: Is an in-person consultation conducted prior to booking?

a.en: Yes, the owner conducts an introductory meet-and-greet to review pet routines, dietary instructions, and home access.

q.en: Does the service offer both dog walking and cat sitting?

a.en: Yes, Top Tails provides midday dog walks along with once- or twice-daily cat drop-in visits for feeding and litter cleaning.
